map_role: Entirely underground tri-vault pressure-relay quarry: three unequal excavated industrial cavities with upper eastbound bore, midheight alternate, deep westbound return and entered service pockets
density_profile: Large distinct uneven mined cavities in an otherwise dense geological envelope, with concentrated working rigs, a long quiet return bore and deliberately excavatable foundation seams

route_grammar.primary: West ignition nest to raised west bore, across rooted diaphragm gates and all three subterranean vaults, down the east turning gallery, west along the deep repair return to the west finish
route_grammar.alternative: At the first vault leave the high north gate and enter the midheight South tri-vault bypass; rejoin in the eastern condenser vault, then descend and return on the shared lower bore
route_grammar.obstruction: A physical upper gate solid closure covers the named North tri-vault throat, while the middle bypass and the finish remain 31x27 accessible from the unchanged spawn
route_grammar.recovery: West recovery shaft and low-bore return are connected with the starting room; top and bottom service chambers are actual entered cave pockets

strong_motifs: Three asymmetrically carved underground mineral caverns
Two roof-to-floor mineral diaphragms with three navigation-grade gate elevations
Central split pressure arms and diagnostic tower
Deep industrial maintenance spaces carved into bedrock
interesting_relationships: The two grounded inter-cavern diaphragms encode a repeatable nested-cavity adjacency grammar, but each has distinct upper and middle passage geometry
Engineering rigs are tethered by actual load-bearing material cells to geological roots, not isolated non-colliding scenery
A mid-height bypass avoids the destructible upper gate without replacing the western finish or lower return
The exposed service-pod alcoves are off the core race path but accessed by vertical shafts
authoring_affordances: Open unused sides of each vault can receive later procedural building parts
Unoccupied basal mine tongues at the first and third vaults are intentionally editable
Three real service rooms support future NPC workstations without occupying route lanes
The central pressure-diaphragm gap can gain machinery and shutters if native flight tests establish clearances

procedural_exemplar_value: A grounded-rock negative-space grammar: start from unequal cavities within a fully supported solid envelope, connect them using three independently navigable bore bands, insert load-bearing industrial equipment while retaining conservative flyable clearance, and preserve unfinished service pockets for later architectural grammars.
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Cinderlift's opposing open-air cliffs, Morrow's suspended islands, Aster's exposed paired hulls, Beaconfold's sky towers above an underground express, or Rookfall's single open caldera, this is a roof-closed, multi-cavity quarry with three repeated-but-nonidentical pressure vaults and longitudinal internal gate relationships. It contains no ship, sky race section, annular central rotor or broken bridge motif.
